name: 98258 · Lake Stevens, WA
findings: ZIP 98258 (Lake Stevens) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98258 (Lake Stevens) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98258 (Lake Stevens) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
